label: Operator universality
title: Universal approximation to nonlinear operators by neural networks with arbitrary activation functions and its application to dynamical systems
summary: Early neural-network approximation theorem for nonlinear operators.
limits: An existence result, not a guarantee of efficient training or recovery from arbitrary sparse observations.
publication_status: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks 6(4):911–917; DOI 10.1109/72.392253

label: Empirical interpolation
title: An empirical interpolation method: application to efficient reduced-basis discretization of partial differential equations
summary: Builds a reduced representation of parameter-dependent functions using selected evaluation points.
limits: Historical foundation for avoiding expensive full-domain evaluations. Its original target is reduced-basis PDE computation, not training a neural operator.
authors: ["Maxime Barrault", "Yvon Maday", "Ngoc Cuong Nguyen", "Anthony T. Patera"]
publication_status: Comptes Rendus Mathematique 339 (2004), 667–672; DOI 10.1016/j.crma.2004.08.006

label: DEIM
title: Discrete Empirical Interpolation for Nonlinear Model Reduction
summary: Uses a reduced basis and selected entries to cheaply approximate nonlinear terms.
limits: A key baseline for sample-efficient evaluation. The original technical-report URL was inaccessible; bibliography verified through the author page and SIAM article, without claiming full-text review.
publication_status: Rice technical report TR09-05 (2009); precursor to SIAM J. Sci. Comput. 2010 DEIM article

label: Stable compressed sensing
title: Stable Signal Recovery from Incomplete and Inaccurate Measurements
summary: Establishes stable sparse-signal recovery from incomplete noisy linear measurements under conditions on the measurement matrix.
limits: Explains why sparsity alone is insufficient: the measurement process must expose the sparse representation. A foundation, not a universal neural-network speedup theorem.
publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

label: Sparse operator identification
title: Identification of Sparse Linear Operators
summary: Identifies structured linear operators from probing signals under conditions on their spreading-function support.
limits: Direct predecessor for learning the operator itself through sparse recovery. The specific time-frequency operator class matters; its guarantees do not cover arbitrary temperature-conditioned kernels.
publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

label: SINDy
title: Discovering governing equations from data: Sparse identification of nonlinear dynamical systems
summary: Fits sparse combinations of candidate nonlinear functions to discover dynamical equations from data.
limits: Useful sparse-regression comparator. Learning an evolution equation differs from learning a finite-horizon solution operator; derivative estimation and the dictionary are consequential.
authors: ["Steven L. Brunton", "Joshua L. Proctor", "J. Nathan Kutz"]
publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

label: Sparse polynomial approximation
title: Compressed sensing approaches for polynomial approximation of high-dimensional functions
summary: Reviews structured sparse polynomial approximation and weighted recovery for high-dimensional functions.
limits: Seed paper. Its sparsity and regularity assumptions motivate faster kernel identification; they do not establish that an arbitrary learned integrand has a sparse expansion.
publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

label: Generative compressed sensing
title: Compressed Sensing using Generative Models
summary: Uses the range of a generative model as a prior for recovering signals from limited measurements.
limits: Connects learned structure to recovery guarantees. This concerns recovering a signal using a learned prior, not automatically accelerating training of that prior.
publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

label: Empirical cubature
title: Dimensional hyper-reduction of nonlinear finite element models via empirical cubature
summary: Selects integration points and positive weights to reproduce reduced internal-force integrals in finite-element models.
limits: Closest classical baseline for the proposed inference acceleration. A quadrature rule fitted to snapshots must be checked on unseen fields and operating regimes.
publication_status: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering 313 (2017), 687–722

label: World Models
title: World Models
summary: Learns a compact predictive environment model and trains a controller using that representation.
limits: Historical bridge to learned simulation for control. A latent recurrent world model is not a discretization-convergent neural operator.
publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

label: DeepONet
title: DeepONet: Learning nonlinear operators for identifying differential equations based on the universal approximation theorem of operators

publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified
